definitions.gloss: char marks; browning on the surface of food
definitions.explanation: the browned or slightly charred marks on food created by high heat, often considered desirable for flavor and appearance

examples.japanese: ⟦{肉|にく}→肉：02240_niku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{焦|こ}げ{目|め}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧。
examples.english: Sear the meat to get char marks.

examples.japanese: ⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧{焦|こ}げ{目|め}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ついた。
グラタン⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{焦|こ}げ{目|め}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧つく⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦オーブン→オーブン：04674_oobun⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{焼|や}く→焼く：01123_yaku⟧。
examples.english: Bake the gratin in the oven until it gets browned on top.

notes:
COOKING TERM:
{焦|こ}げ{目|め} refers to the desirable browning or char marks on food, which adds flavor through the Maillard reaction and caramelization.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {焦|こ}げ{目|め}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧ - to brown/sear (to create char marks)
- {焦|こ}げ{目|め}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧つく - char marks form
- ⟦きれい→きれい：00717_kirei⟧な{焦|こ}げ{目|め} - nice browning

DESIRABLE VS BURNT:
{焦|こ}げ{目|め} (desirable browning) is different from {焦|こ}げ (burnt). Good {焦|こ}げ{目|め} adds:
- Flavor depth
- Visual appeal
- Crispy texture

COMMON DISHES:
- グラタン - gratin (browned cheese on top)
- ⟦{焼|や}き{魚|ざかな}→焼き魚：13406_yakizakana⟧ - grilled fish
- ⟦ステーキ→ステーキ：01369_suteeki⟧ - steak
- {焼|や}き⟦おにぎり→おにぎり：04956_onigiri⟧ - grilled rice ball
